codeReview.summary: The PurchaseService migration successfully implements all requirements: it extends PurchasesService from generated code, preserves atomic items operations via createWithItems, and uses FK references (purchase_id in payload) instead of syncGroupId for item synchronization. The service compiles without type errors.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The PurchaseService.createWithItems pattern demonstrates how to handle atomic parent-child operations: queue parent sync first (without explicit ordering dependency), then queue children with FK reference in payload. The server's OperationSorter handles topological ordering based on FK references in payload.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: purchase-service.ts:228-261 - Parent queued first, then items queued with purchaseId FK reference

sharedStateObservations.observation: The migration correctly uses camelCase property names (supplierId, purchaseDate, totalAmount) matching @avileo/shared schema types, though consuming code still uses legacy snake_case. This is a pre-existing codebase issue, not a migration issue.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff notes 68 type errors in consuming code using snake_case - resolved in follow-up feature m4-fix-purchase-consuming-code

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the frontend-migrate-worker procedure: extended generated base class, preserved custom methods (createWithItems, item management), and ensured proper type compatibility.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows implementation followed AGENTS.md Service Migration Pattern exactly
